edit.statement: A standard vanilla put option gives its holder the right to buy the underlying at the strike under its exercise terms.
edit.subject: A standard vanilla put option
edit.object: right to buy the underlying at the strike
edit.old_object: right to sell the underlying at the strike
edit.original: A standard vanilla put option gives its holder the right to sell the underlying at the strike under its exercise terms.
edit.scope: All instances of the stated class at the benchmark timestamp; only the designated definition/category/constraint is replaced. Other relations remain unspecified or unchanged.
